card.name: Looking back and knowing now
card.fires_on: The word 'back' in 'Looking back' and 'know' in 'Knowing what I know' before 'now', in reflective personal writing. It also fires on single digits inside ISBN and DOI numbers.

card.plain: It lights up on phrases like 'looking back' or 'knowing what I know', where 'now' or 'hindsight' comes next, and on digits inside ISBN codes.
